maya: Plan for tonight: phased rollout US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 22:45-02:45 UTC. Target release: v2.16.0-canary. Canary in us-central for 12m, then 3-step ramp. Reserve note: dedicated warm pools current: us 110k, eu 75k, apac 48k tokens/min. Requesting reserve +10k in US/EU.
liam: I can allocate +10k in US/EU. APAC partner quota fixed, we can only do soft-burst +6k.
noah: Runtime highlight: v2.16.0 tweaks batching heuristic and KV expiry defaults. Expect improved avg latency but watch tail for long conversations.
maya: Rollback triggers draft: (A) sustained error rate +8% 5m, (B) p95 latency up +120ms 10m, (C) Dedicated pool fill >90% for 4m. Rollback pin -> v2.15.2.
infra-bot: rule added: dedicated_fill>90pct_4m -> post thread + route 30%->hosted:q4-fallback.
deploy-bot: Canary launch: v2.16.0 -> us-central-canary slot c4. Health probes ON. Logs: https://logs.company/release/1759004444
liam: Canary smoke: spike 1000rps 45s, run 15 prod prompts, embedding check, cost delta. Triggering spike now: `deploy-bot spike 1000rps 45s`
deploy-bot: spike accepted. Monitoring GPU, queue-length, latency. Report in ~50s.
rachel: Net config: local-preferred routing; EU will start at 10% only after US stable 20m. APAC pacing max 10% per 20m due to partner.
noah: Observability: added quick KV hit and batch size panels: https://obs/release/1759004444
liam: Canary results: errors flat, p50 +12ms, p95 +35ms, KV hit +5pct, cost delta negligible.
maya: Start US ramp: 25% -> 60% in two steps (12m intervals) then 100% gated at 23:30 UTC if steady. EU hold.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift applied: us-central->us-region 25%. snapshot r-1759004444-1
liam: After shift: warm pool +9k fill, CPU steady. Reserve +10k applied US/EU. APAC remains soft-burst.
rachel: Added mem_pressure alert: mem_pressure_us > 70% for 3m -> page oncall.
infra-bot: page rule created.
maya: If APAC hits partner throttle, plan to divert APAC traffic to hosted fallback with quant profile q4 and tag support.
liam: Also enabling 1% mirror to v2.15.2 for output diffs during ramp. Helps detect quality regressions silently.
noah: Quality guard: semantic fail increase >1.5% on eval set over 10m -> automatic pin to v2.15.2.
maya: Runbook snippet: `runbook:deploy:v2.16.0 -> verify reserves, watch mem_pressure, if trigger -> pin v2.15.2 & open rollcall` Link: https://runbooks/internal/v2.16.0
deploy-bot: canary steady at 18m. Next: us->60% in 10m unless alerts.
liam: Go/no-go at 22:55 UTC. Will post final.
maya: Thanks team. Standby for 22:55. :raised_hands:
